dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} healed Varuna Contraption, so the trees and seeds are lively again.

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: #That's why we are naming Varuna Contraption as {NICKNAME} Contraption, to show our thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: But that would break Nara Varuna's heart, if Nara Varuna comes back.

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: #So Arapandu is trying to make Nara {NICKNAME} and Nara Varuna happy together.
